title: Final Range Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the horizontal range R must be provided.

title: Air Resistance Force
description: Essential Criteria: The derived equation for the force from air resistance must be accurately stated.

title: Position Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The position functions x(t) and y(t) as a function of time must be correctly derived.

title: First Order Correction
description: Important Criteria: The first order correction to the horizontal range must be calculated and presented.

title: Kinematic Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The use of kinematic equations to find time of flight must be clearly shown.

title: Assumptions Stated
description: Optional Criteria: Any assumptions made during the derivation, such as neglecting air resistance initially, should be stated.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units should be checked for consistency throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors in the air resistance force equation or sign mistakes in the equations will result in a deduction.

title: Final Results Presentation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failure to clearly present final results or to box important answers will result in a deduction.
